findings.summary: OSC 4 batches of >=8 pairs were dropped, voiding palette_overridden / has_indexed_colors (lens gate signal). Found independently on 6ed9bc3; fixed in 78192c6 with a test proven RED.
DCS overflow cleared+regrew instead of latching. Bounded but costly; fixed in 7638470. Throughput 284 -> 446 MB/s.

A complete 16-param OSC 8 (URI with 13 semicolons) is dropped. Verified against vte 0.15 directly that complete-14 and truncated-30 dispatches are byte-identical, so the false positive is unavoidable and dropping is the correct direction. Documented and pinned by a boundary test.
The vte param-cap drift guard could detect neither a raised nor a lowered cap - a defect in verification machinery. Replaced by a direct behavioural probe via OSC 4 that detects both directions.

window.snapshot silently clips from the TOP when a pane grid is taller than the window layout rect. NOT split-related (corrected). Deterministic, monotonic, byte-identical on a 3s retry so not a race. Byte-identical on b521f2c. Needs its own issue.
Committed evidence understated the work (13 RED recorded vs 16 actual; REP worst case unrecorded). Refreshed in 7638470; refreshed figures match my measurements.
